items.title: Attack on Titan
items.reason: A dark post-apocalyptic mystery-action series whose complete run continually converts apparent monster-survival rules into deeper hidden systems: Titan identities and powers, the walls, the royal government, the basement truth, Marley, Paths and the Founding Titan. Across four seasons it combines sustained mystery and progressive revelation with deception, factional strategy, varied Titan abilities, escalating power and stakes, extreme brutality, body horror, gore, large-scale action and a strange world whose history is repeatedly recontextualized.
